items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: He was a national name around Natchez... I remember well... they used to hire him sometimes to play

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Bud Scott or Walter Vons up there? In Natchez, by the way, where we were mentioning? Bud Scott?
Yeah, that's the name I'm thinking about, Bud Scott. He was a national name around Natchez, like Cleveland Williams was around Donisonville.
What did Bud Scott do? I want to get this started.
